names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 20 ianuarie.

Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Лаврентий (Проскура) Черниговский, прп.»: «прп.» is a rank word and is stripped, the surname and the see-epithet kept. The day line itself gives only «Лаврентия Черниговского». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE; the folder had no Cyrillic form.

birth.note: doxologia.ro's life: «Sfântul Lavrentie din Cernigov – după numele său de botez, Luca Evseevici Proscura – s-a născut în anul 1868, în localitatea rusească Karilsk, din regiunea Cernigov.»

death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «Sfântul Cuvios Lavrentie de Cernigov a adormit întru Domnul în anul 1950, în ziua Botezului Domnului, la ora 10.30» — on the day of the Theophany, the page says, and it gives no civil date.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 декабря ст. ст. — «Прп. Лаврентия Черниговского (1950).»

attestations.note: The day’s seventh entry. The folder’s only other venerated row is Romanian and keeps him on 20 January in the revised Julian calendar — ANOTHER CHURCH’S DAY, not a second Russian one, and it was not touched; the schema holds one row per church and this calendar’s is 29 December. The line closes «(1950)», the year `laurence-of-chernigov` already reads for Lavrentie of Cernigov, and the name page gives the surname Proskura, which is his. The line’s «Прп.» is the only rank either source gives him and the folder’s `types` were `hieromonk` and `abbot` without it, so `venerable` is added. NO `dates` WERE WRITTEN: the folder already carries its own reading. The reading life6694 was NOT OPENED, the folder’s life being already written. The day page prints seven hymns — two for Mark the Gravedigger, two for the venerable Marcellus and three for the fourteen thousand infants — and none under this name.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 20 ianuarie — «Sfântul Lavrentie de Cernigov»

attestations.note: The calendar keeps him on 20 ianuarie; the life on the same site says he died on the day of the Theophany, 1950.
